judgements.reason: Sharing loved ones' joys; not about mixed feelings.
About giving offerings; off-topic.

About place, not lost purpose.

Implies he wasn't fit for the role; worth by spirit helps only partly.
Delight in others' virtues; thin against pervasive dullness.

Remembering who you wept with; loosely touches companionship.
About injustice; unrelated to career versus parenting.
Overshadowed by others, love makes their greatness yours; reframes envy.
We all struggle and will get somewhere better; encouraging.
I want peace, they want war; mirrors the frustration.
Don't despair of chronic illness; faith over success.
Wander alone, others fools; cold comfort for loneliness.
Disclosing secrets ends friendship; one-sided on the dilemma.

Play your assigned part; may sound like accepting mistreatment.
Focus on what's in your power; relevant when stuck.
End content like a ripe olive; fits ageing, though stark.

Envious silence; may harden his suspicion of his wife.

Unbothered bull and mosquito; light fit for a pesky dog.
Accept fatigue lightly; misses chronic exhaustion.
Rest belongs to work; gentle nudge to rest.
Meditation rest; asks more work from someone exhausted.
Sleep restores; practical and relevant.
Day's work done, let me rest; light and fitting.
Weakness from terror; wrong tone for sore feet.
Weariness from corruption; heavy and off for sore feet.

Absolute repose; abstract.
Rest belongs to work; light fit.
